title: Nai Soun Ditta Pal Zainab
body:
Ohdi Neend Di Haar Ik Jhonkay Tay (x2) Ohnu Naiziyaan Naal Jagaanda Reya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Akh Meetay Na Vich Safraan Day Ay Thaki Hoyi Shaam-e-gharibaan Di (x2)
Karbal Tun Shaam Taayein Jaakar (x2) Haakim Da Hukam Nibhaanda Reya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab Diyaan Akhiyaan Di Laali Sajjad Nu Khoon Ruwayi Si (x2)
Dukh Zainab Di Jagraateyan Da (x2) Beemar Nu Khoon Ruwaanda Reya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Main Aakhri Had Haan Ismat Di Sajjad Khuda Tu Ghairat Da (x2)
Meray Kabay Wargay Mahmal Di (x2) Haar Kufi Pathar Vasaanda Reya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zahra Diyaan Nuwaan Saab Roiyaan Ay Haalat Vekh Kay Zainab Di (x2)
Shabbir Nay Saang Tay Vain Kitay (x2) Abbas Da Saar Takraanda Reya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ik Ujray Rukh Tay Haith Kita Maa Awn Di Lay Aaram Ay (x2)
Meri Sain Di Kayi Ab Chehre Tay (x2) Zaalim Koray Barsaanda Reya.
